family.regular: Enrollments paused for leave or suspension resume, and the family is billed monthly again.
family.trial: The family gets no monthly invoices; its enrollments do not change.
family.on_leave: Enrollments pause and upcoming classes are cancelled; weekly times are kept for the return to “Regular”. No monthly invoices during the leave.
family.suspended: Enrollments pause and upcoming classes are cancelled; weekly times are kept. No monthly invoices while suspended.
family.deactivated: Enrollments end today and upcoming classes are cancelled; they do not come back if the family is reactivated. No monthly invoices.

student.active: The student is active again and counted in the family's next invoice. Ended enrollments do not resume; create a new one from the schedule.
student.inactive: The student's enrollments end today, upcoming classes are cancelled and the student is left out of the family's next invoice.

teacher.active: The teacher shows in availability search again and can get new classes.
teacher.inactive: The teacher leaves availability search and gets no new classes, and can still sign in to see payslips.

staff.active: The staff member can sign in again with their role's permissions.
staff.inactive: The staff member cannot sign in and is signed out on every device.

archive.title: Delete {name}?
archive.done: {name} was deleted and moved to the archive
archive.banner: Deleted on {date} by {name}. The record is read-only until you restore it.

deactivateFirst.family: An active family cannot be deleted. Change its status to “Deactivated” first (its enrollments end and upcoming classes are cancelled), then delete it.
deactivateFirst.student: An active student cannot be deleted. Change the status to “Inactive” first, then delete the student.
deactivateFirst.teacher: An active teacher cannot be deleted. Deactivate the teacher first (after moving or ending their students' enrollments), then delete.
deactivateFirst.staff: An active account cannot be deleted. Deactivate it first, then delete it.

effect.family: The family and its children move to the archive and leave the lists, and the parent's login is closed. Nothing is erased: invoices, payments and class history stay, and the family can be restored from “Deleted”.
effect.student: The student moves to the archive and leaves the lists. Class history, progress and the family's invoices stay, and the student can be restored from “Deleted”.
effect.teacher: The teacher moves to the archive, leaves the lists and can no longer sign in. Class, salary and payslip history stay, and the teacher can be restored from “Deleted”.
effect.staff: The staff member moves to the archive and cannot sign in. Everything they recorded stays in the change log, and they can be restored from “Deleted”.
